title: Classification of Toona sinensis Young Leaves Using Machine Learning and UAV-Borne Hyperspectral Imagery
summary: UAV-borne hyperspectral imaging and SVM distinguish young from old Toona sinensis leaves; the study reports held-out classification and feature analysis, supporting a specific crop-quality phenotyping result. Held-out validation and wavelength-feature analysis are reported in original Methods/Results.
